heading: Presumption as to electronic agreements.
text: The Court shall presume that every electronic record purporting to be an agreement containing the [5][electronic signature] of the parties was so concluded by affixing the [6][electronic signature] of the parties.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Ins. by Act 21 of 2000, s. 92, and the Second Schedule (w.e.f. 17-10-2000).
Subs. by Act 10 of 2009, s. 52, for “digital signature” (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Subs. by ibid., s. 52, for “Digital Signature Certificate” (w.e.f. 27.10.2009).
